summary: Docs 50 (Home Passport), 55 (Material Intelligence), 57 (Pro Collaboration), 58 (Maintenance deltas), 59 (Budget deltas) tested end-to-end. Backend: 37/37 pytest cases green — passport summary/counts/timeline+profile 400, materials workspace/tabs/quantity-calc (paint 420 area / 2 coats / 350 coverage / 10% waste => 3 gallons, basis=user_entered; no-area path returns measured|estimated w/ requires_confirmation), substitution 'gas line'→prohibited deterministically + use-anyway 409, purchase-readiness 5 checks w/ safety_equipment safety_critical=true, readiness-override 409 for safety / 400 empty reason / ok for tools, shopping shape, receipt upload returns pending_review w/ Low confidence and items shape, tools listing, procollab meta/create-draft (minimum-share: notes=false, sharing_review includes NEVER_SHARED list) / edit-sharing / submit + 409 on re-submit + 409 on edit-after-submit, admin under_review + response (professional_responded), user accept writes pi_change_events (change_type=professional_recommendation) + hi_project_notes, hybrid shape, ownership toggle diy<->professional, maintenance skip-reasons=5 + skip 'no_materials' returns next_action w/ route + skip 'not_applicable' pauses task, followup/from-project idempotent (2nd call created=false, same task id), budget expense add 400 on negative + persistence + budget-workspace shape (estimated_total, purchased_total = mat.actual + expenses, remaining, status in {on_track,at_risk,over_budget,no_target}, confidence in {high,medium,low}), change apply→reject 409, reject sets user_decision=rejected while applied stays user_decision=approved. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): logged in as demo_home via /auth?mode=login — /home-intel shows hi-passport link. /home-intel/passport renders profile card + 6 tiles + Home timeline groups; edit modal (passport-edit → passport-year → passport-save) persisted year=2002. /home-intel/projects/materials?id=<pid> renders mat-ready-count ('1 of 8 items'), readiness card w/ safety-critical block, all 5 tabs, Shopping Mode button; calc modal returned '3 gallon(s)' via calc-area=420 → calc-run → calc-result. /home-intel/projects/shopping shows shop-remaining='7 items remaining'. /home-intel/projects/budget renders budget-status, budget-purchased, budget-add-expense; expense modal (exp-label/exp-amount/exp-save) added $9.99 and purchased-total updated to $34.99 live. /home-intel/projects/pro-help renders pro-help-remote_review; after help-type selected → pro-question + pro-prepare appear, pro-prepare produces sharing review with pro-share-notes + pro-send. BUG: /home-intel/projects/{id} crashes with 'p.cleanup_disposal.map is not a function' at ProjectWorkspace — the proj-budget and proj-pro-help buttons never render because the screen white-screens. testID mismatch: spec calls tile 'passport-tile-projects' but code emits 'passport-tile-projects_total' (tile renders; only automation key differs).

ui_bugs.issue: TypeError: p.cleanup_disposal.map is not a function — screen crashes and neither proj-budget nor proj-pro-help buttons render for demo_home's Floating Shelf project. cleanup_disposal appears to be a non-array (likely a string) at runtime so `?.length > 0` passes but `.map(...)` throws. Guard with Array.isArray(p.cleanup_disposal) before mapping.

Problem statement expects testID 'passport-tile-projects' but code emits 'passport-tile-projects_total' (keyed by counts field name). Rename to 'projects' or update spec; the tile renders correctly, this is only an automation-selector mismatch.

integration_issues.issue: Because the ProjectWorkspace crashes, users cannot navigate to the new /projects/budget or /projects/pro-help screens from the project card. Direct URL still works, and both target screens themselves render + persist correctly (verified via ?id=<pid>).

action_items: HIGH: Fix ProjectWorkspace crash at /app/frontend/app/home-intel/projects/[id].tsx:293 — replace `p.cleanup_disposal?.length > 0 && (...p.cleanup_disposal.map(...))` with `Array.isArray(p.cleanup_disposal) && p.cleanup_disposal.length > 0 && (...)`. Same defensive pattern likely needed for other array-typed fields on the same page. Retest that proj-budget and proj-pro-help now render.
LOW: Either rename projects tile key to 'projects' (map counts.projects_total→'projects') or update spec/tests to use 'passport-tile-projects_total'.
critical_code_review_comments: home_passport_engine.py — clean layering. Timeline aggregates project/asset/room/measurement/receipt/maintenance/knowledge events, filters for `at`, and returns month groups keyed by _month_label. counts.projects_total + counts.projects_completed both surfaced; tile uses projects_total.

material_intelligence_engine.py — quantity_calc math: raw = area*coats/coverage; qty = ceil(raw*(1+waste/100)). For 420,2,350,10% → raw=2.4, qty=ceil(2.64)=3 ✓. Substitution 'gas line' hits deterministic PROHIBITED_TERMS pre-LLM check → prohibited. Readiness override endpoint short-circuits: check_id=='safety_equipment' → 409 before reason validation. Receipt endpoint returns pending_review + confidence tolerant to LLM output.

pro_collab_engine.py — minimum-share default is exactly {photos:T, measurements:T, products:T, notes:F, project_history:T}; sharing_review includes 'Project title'/'Your question' + labels for enabled perms and lists NEVER_SHARED (address / other rooms / unrelated projects / private account info). submit_handoff and edit_sharing both return 409 once status!=draft. accept_response writes pi_change_events with change_type='professional_recommendation' + source='pro_handoff' and inserts hi_project_notes with source='professional_response'.

maintenance_engine.py — followup/from-project idempotent via existing filter on project_id+source='post_project'; skip endpoint returns next_action for no_materials/need_professional and pauses task for not_applicable. New occurrence inserted only when frequency has next-due.
project_intelligence_engine.py — reject_change 409 when status=='applied'; both apply and reject set user_decision on the change event so budget-workspace confidence and history are consistent.

rca_of_issue: BUG: proj-budget & proj-pro-help buttons never render. RCA: /app/frontend/app/home-intel/projects/[id].tsx line 293 does `p.cleanup_disposal?.length > 0 && ...p.cleanup_disposal.map(c => ...)`. For demo_home's project the cleanup_disposal field is not an Array so `.length` exists (probably a string) making the guard truthy but `.map` throws — the whole ProjectWorkspace component errors and its later JSX (including the proj-budget and proj-pro-help Pressables) never renders. Reproduction: login as demo_home → open /home-intel/projects/49186adc-f93a-4417-96f3-9b6178193c77 → observe blank screen and console TypeError. Fix: wrap with Array.isArray guard: `Array.isArray(p.cleanup_disposal) && p.cleanup_disposal.length > 0 && (...)` (do the same for any other list-typed fields nearby that came from LLM output).
